title: Model Supply-Demand Radar & Competitive Forensics Playbook
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: build a repeatable playbook and a lightweight radar dashboard that maps model supply (availability, pricing, quantization variants) to customer demand signals (latency sensitivity, embeddings volume, RAG usage) across target verticals. Scope: 1) Data pipelines to ingest public model releases and pricing changes; 2) heuristics to classify model viability for Redwood deployments (hosting, dedicated, private); 3) a competitive forensics checklist to evaluate sudden model outages, licensing shifts, or quality regressions; 4) handoff artifacts for SRE, Sales, and Solutions to trigger capacity/procurement actions. Out of scope: heavy ML benchmarking lab (we will reuse Research microbenchmarks).
success_criteria: Prototype radar dashboard with top 15 models and region-aware availability
Forensics checklist and runbook adopted by SRE & Sales on first pilot
Automated alerting rule that flags >20% regional supply delta within 24h
acceptance_criteria: Data ingestion: daily feeds for model releases, price changes, and open-source repo tags
Classification: models annotated with deployment-fit (hosted/dedicated/private) and confidence score
Runbook: documented steps, owners, and play triggers stored in Confluence
Dashboard: filter by region, latency tier, and enterprise impact; exported CSV for Sales
